changelog: Production-Ready Release: Genuine signed Android release binary (~1.3 MB) distributed on GitHub Releases.
User Authentication & Android KeyStore Vault: Hardware-backed AES-GCM encrypted session storage supporting Login, Registration, and Offline Guest modes.
Streamlined 4-Tab Navigation: Consolidated app sections into Today, Planner (integrated Schedule & Habits), Insights, and Account.
Larger Typography & Enhanced Legibility: Scaled up font sizes and touch targets across all screens for effortless readability.
Automated In-App Update Engine: Verified remote manifest fetching, streaming APK downloads, and SHA-256 integrity checks.
Clean Architecture: Removed legacy developer test controls in favor of dynamic production Room database and WorkManager sync.
